title: Northgate Optical Special-Order Blank Return Schedule
content:
On an in-lab cancellation of a Northgate Optical job carrying a material upgrade charge, the lab retention percentage depends on the number of lab days.

**Schedule.** Where the lab days are no more than 10 and a material upgrade charge was posted on the job, the special-order blanks can still go back to the supplier and the lab retention percentage is 35 percent; where the lab days are 11 to 21 and a material upgrade charge was posted, it is 45 percent. A job with no material upgrade charge, or with more than 21 lab days, is outside this schedule.

**Lab days.** The calendar days from the lab-day start to the day the refund is worked out.

| Lab days | Material upgrade charge posted on the job | Lab retention percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 0 to 10 | yes | 35 percent |
| 11 to 21 | yes | 45 percent |
| more than 21 | yes | outside this schedule |
| any | no | outside this schedule |

A material upgrade charge counts as posted whether or not a refund has since been credited against it.

### Edges (hypothetical job, lab-day start 1 October 2025, material upgrade charge posted)

| Refund worked out on | Lab days | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 11 October 2025 | 10 | 35 percent |
| 12 October 2025 | 11 | 45 percent |
| 22 October 2025 | 21 | 45 percent |
| 23 October 2025 | 22 | outside this schedule |
